## What changes and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Note remaining limits. For UI changes, include screenshots using synthetic data.

## Compatibility

Describe any data, API, configuration or migration impact. Write “None” when not applicable.

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation reflects the behavior.
- [ ] Tests cover a meaningful behavior change, or the reason no new test is needed is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private deployment details or unlicensed assets are included.
